Seriously, if they had charged any less, there would have been no profit for them at all. That tells you something; if you do find a lower price, beware, because it's probably a scam. Stick with these guys. They get the job done and they do it in a way that won't destroy your bank account. Juan was AMAZING!

reviews.author: Christopher Hall
reviews.text: Came to my house and changed the thermostat in my 2016 Ford Explorer Sport. He was quick and professional. It took him all of thirty minutes. Great price too.

reviews.author: Jesse Ellyson
reviews.text: Long story which I won't bother you with. What matters is the end. Price tag! Oh my, beyond affordable. Seriously, if they had charged any less, there would have been no profit for them at all. That tells you something; if you do find a lower price, beware, because it's probably a scam. Stick with these guys. They get the job done and they do it in a way that won't destroy your bank account.

reviews.author: Vario Picasso
reviews.text: Juan was AMAZING! I needed front brakes and to check a leak under my car. Juan scheduled me the same day I contacted him. Fixed my brakes and diagnosed the leak in less than an hour. During the brake work, Juan showed me how badly my rotor had worn down, I then scheduled him to fix my rotors a few days later. He arrived ahead of time and fixed both rotors. Needless to say, Juan is now my mechanic. Hands down the best car service experience I’ve ever had. We need more mechanics like Juan who are knowledgeable with reasonable pricing and seek to educate their customers. I will definitely be working with Juan for all my future automotive needs!

reviews.author: David Struhs
reviews.text: Fantastic experience with them. Communicated clearly and quickly via text. Came right to where my car was broken down 5 minutes early (he let me know exactly when he could take care of it - even on a Sunday). Let me know when he was 30 minutes out. Was super respectful and worked quickly. Replaced my alternator and got me up and running. Very fair price. Overall would highly recommend - it was a lot easier than getting the car towed and then waiting for a shop to open on monday to fix it. Great service.

reviews.author: Cristi Wells
reviews.text: We stopped and checked the camper out while traveling and found a hot wheel hub on one side. We called A and J, Juan showed up to the parking lot we were in and jacked our camper up. He pulled and cleaned the hub, regreased the wheel bearing. The hub spindle nut seemed loose causing the brake pads to rub on inside of the drum. He checked the pads and they were still ok. After he put the tire back on, he let us follow him to make sure the issue was fixed before we went on our way. Still after 2 hours of driving the wheel hub has stayed cool! Thank you Juan!

reviews.author: Emma Hamblet
reviews.text: Great experience! My car battery died and was stuck in my apartment complex parking lot. I needed to go to work the next day and I was desperately trying to find someone who could come out last minute. I explained the situation, and he was able to fit me in the next morning before I went to work. He was easy to communicate with, took the exact amount of time he quoted me, and I felt the price for labor, parts, and coming to me early in the morning was very fair. Thanks again!

reviews.author: Elle Ballard
reviews.text: My experience with A&J Roadside was great! I am very grateful Juan came to my house to replace both my front and back brakes and rotors. He was communicative, nice and worked quickly. They also have unbeatable prices. I will be reaching out to them again for future work.

reviews.author: Melissa Henderson
reviews.text: TOP NOTCH PROFESSIONAL! The brakes on my 2020 Toyota RAV4 started making grinding noises on Tuesday and I knew I had to get them fixed right away. I immediately googled for a mobile mechanic near me and saw that A&J was highly rated & had super positive and detailed reviews by previous customers. I sent Juan a text on Wednesday morning for a quote on front & back brake pads and pads + rotors. I got an immediate reply to allow him 30 minutes and he’d have a quote for me. I received that quote in less time and at an EXTREMELY AFFORDABLE price. Times are hard for everyone right now but A&J’s pricing was definitely within my right budget. I asked a couple of service questions and felt secure that Juan was the person for the job. I quickly secured my appointment for this morning (Thursday), provided my VIN# and address. Juan confirmed right away and also texted me this morning communicating his ETA. He arrived promptly, greeted me with a smile and after a bit of small talk said he’d be done in about an hour. Sure enough he texted when he was complete and I met him promptly with payment. It’s been a few hours after service and my SUV is driving quietly and breaking smoothly just as it did from the dealership. A&J HAS A NEW CUSTOMER IN ME! I’m so appreciative of the communication, customer service, pricing and availability and will absolutely be calling Juan again for future services. Thank you again, sincerely for your hard work.

reviews.author: Uu Ba
reviews.text: Just this morning, I was stuck on the street with a snapped alternated belt, and i kid you not he fixed in 30 minutes then I decided to ask him to replace the break pads again I am not even kidding he did in like 15min. This was the most pleasant service experience I have ever had when it comes to car related stuff. Highly recommend. Juan, you are the best!

reviews.author: Joren B
reviews.text: I suggest everybody call this guy whenever you run into problems with your car!! I was having spark plug issue gave him a call that night and he arrived the next morning. Let me know what was going and and explained everything very well. I know cars but not that much. He is even mobile which makes it better especially if your car is no condition to run well. I will definitely be giving him a call if there are anymore problems

reviews.author: Chris gardner
reviews.text: I would leave a review for service but there was no service to be had at all. He gave me an estimate and we were going to set up an appointment but this guy would not answer any of my calls or texts the following day and I really would have appreciated if he had at least communicated with me but he did not at all. Don't waste your time with this guy. However I highly recommend going through Mobile Man Mechanics! Aaron is a great guy with low prices and high character with quality and he actually communicates

reviews.author: Miss Edna Ankrah
reviews.text: I had an amazing experience! I was having trouble with my car coolant, and instead of towing it to a shop, I decided to try a mobile mechanic service. Juan was quick to respond, and he arrived on time, fully prepared to handle the issue. Juan was professional, friendly, and knowledgeable. Diagnosed my car and replaced my coolant hose and even took the time to check other components of the car to ensure everything was running smoothly.

reviews.author: jeff lott
reviews.text: AandJroadside was a lifesaver. Juan came on time as scheduled, told me what he was repairing, showed me what he was repairing and did it in a quick fashion. The convenience of having him come to my home was more than I could ask for. I have already started passing his name and number around to my family and friends. Also upon returning from vacation I will be having him come back and repair a few things for preventive maintenance. Thanks again Juan for answering my call.

reviews.author: Emily Marquez
reviews.text: Best experience!! Juan was quick to answer and get the job done. Instead of taking my car all the way to the shop, he was able to come to me. He also charged me a fair price for the work. Definitely recommend!!

reviews.author: Andrew Goncalves
reviews.text: I had an excellent experience with A&J Roadside. They responded quickly and arrived onsite within an hour, even in snowy weather. Juan efficiently replaced my car battery, which was located under the passenger seat, a tricky and frustrating spot to access. His professionalism and prompt service made a stressful situation much easier. Highly recommend!!

reviews.author: olatunde eniojukan
reviews.text: Great reliable service, always my go to person for repairs on both my car and box truck. Great pricing, fast repairs.

reviews.author: Megan Franco
reviews.text: Juan was awesome. Right before the snow I started to have engine issues. After the snowfall, Juan came out to diagnose the issue and came up with a game plan. He replaced spark plugs and a few ignition coils for a very reasonable price. He also explained the issue to me in a way that made sense. Check him out for your needs!

reviews.author: Steve Graham
reviews.text: Another positive review for Juan! I had a bolt in my tire and didn't want to spend all day dealing with a repair shop. Juan was prompt in responding to my request and had my tire patched, mounted, and filled in in no time. I can recommend Juan and A&J without hesitation!

reviews.author: Jalyza Figueroa
reviews.text: The process was quick and easy. Juan even came to my job to replace my spark plugs so I wouldn’t have to miss work by traveling to him. Would definitely recommend to friends and family.

reviews.author: Chenne ChristopherWood
reviews.text: Best car maintenance experience in over 12 years , I had a ghost issue that hadn't been properly diagnosed after several attempts over a period of a year with 2 other mechanics not being able to pin point the issue, in past few days the symptoms progressed I called 5 mechanics two of which kept me on hold for 30mins, and the other 3 never returned the call. I reached out to A and J and they answered in less than 3 rings , allowed me to explain in full detail before cutting me off offered to come to me on a rainy day and had affordable rates. Juan was professional, had excellent communication, was knowledgeable without being a pushy salesman. Asked the right question which allowed me to focus on my needs vs goals in order to make the best decision for myself. He quoted be both rated and provided his professional opinion based on prevention and longevity. He completed the work before lunch $1000 cheaper than the other 3 mechanics that finally returned my call by the time he came, diagnosed and completed the work! What I liked the most is I was work and could remain productive all while resolving my personal issue also no hassle to drop off and pick up , and quality professional service is the

reviews.author: Xtophers Ozuzu
reviews.text: AandJroadside should be your first stop for your auto repairs. They came to my house and fixed my brake pads (all 4), rear Calipers and all four rotors. They are affordable, punctual and courteous. A& J!! Way to go!. .

reviews.author: Larry White
reviews.text: I had an Awesome experience wit A&J Roadside! My Friend Juan a an Awesome Mechanic! I would recommend anyone 2 book him 4 any Service! Great wit a Great Personality & Work Ethic as Well as his Buddy tht he also works with!

reviews.author: Ll Bo
reviews.text: Had some issues with my alternator and Juan came out fixed it right up for me, He's a great mechanic. Having any issues with your vehicle I'd recommend checking out A&J roadside.

reviews.author: Moises Gomez
reviews.text: I never knew about mobile mechanics and how it works so i called Aandjroadside and spoke with Juan and the service they provided was better then going to a shop! Which blew my mind . I took my vehicle to get inspected and they told me i needed rotors,brakes,tie rods and struts before i can get my inspection for the year. They were charging me almost 1,800$ at the shop which i couldnt afford. So i found Aandjroadside and they did all the work including parts for less then half of the price i got at the shop! I set up a appointment with Juan and they arrived on time and completed the work and i got to watch everything that was being done on my vehicle ! This is my go to company for car work for now on ! Extremely happy and impressed with this company so i had to leave a detailed review!!!! Dealerships and shops are a robbery !! Mobile mechanics is the way to go

reviews.author: Natalie Martinez Lopez
reviews.text: The mechanic was very professional and helpful. I called for road assistance and he arrived under 15 minutes. I will gladly be using him more frequently as he offers multiple services. Definitely recommend!

reviews.author: David Cruz
reviews.text: Very smooth and easy experience. Juan was very professional and his prices are even better! The fact he was able to come and work on my car while I was at work was a PLUS! I highly recommend him and will definitely have him service my vehicle.

reviews.author: Liam Mateo
reviews.text: Awesome service!!! Great work!! Best prices in the dmv!! My vehicles caliper starting leaking and i was stuck on the side of the road and my funds were low thought i had to pay a 400$ tow to get it repaired but from the grace of god i found Juan from Aandjroadside picked up the caliper for me and changed my caliper on the side of the road !!! Saved me 400$ not having to pay for a tow and got me back on the road in no time! Thanks Juan

reviews.author: KireeG
reviews.text: Juan was amazing, he changed my brake pads. It was an amazing experience. He is a professional plus he is a really positive person. We were able to have a great talk while he was getting the pads replaced. Even showed me some stuff around the car to see when I will need stuff changed next. Great guy! Will use him again

reviews.author: Anisa Wallace
reviews.text: Juan came out to my home and fixed the passenger side inner and outer tie rods of my car. He is knowledgeable, reliable and reasonably priced. Definitely will be using his services and recommending him to friends and family!

reviews.author: Faye
reviews.text: Juan was very professional and courteous, super nice and super fast. He went out of his way to help me when I didn’t know what was going on with my car. He’s definitely my mechanic now. Definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Kaleigh
reviews.text: I needed an oil change last minute today & searched all over checking reviews, A&J was my final choice after all the positive feedback I read! Juan was extremely polite & fast! Not only was he on time but he arrived even earlier than we talked about! Definitely will use A&J again!!!!

reviews.author: Suntana Kennemore
reviews.text: Juan was awesome! Came right away and educated me as he was doing the diagnosis. He even checked my tire pressure. Honest nice guy and after getting ripped off by Firestone he really was a god send!!

reviews.author: Russel Bunuan
reviews.text: Last night my alternator gave up and it almost snap the belt. 1 call for Juan i got my qoute and he fix it the next day. I asked him how long it will be done and he said about an hour. And he lied to me. He finished it in 40minutes. Quality job, honest mechanic. My new car mechanic.

reviews.author: Bibi Estrada
reviews.text: Came to my home to change my alternator and battery at a good price very good quality work. Highly recommend

reviews.author: Faytrick Smith
reviews.text: Juan came out to replace brakes (front and back) on my bull (Ford Taurus). He did an outstanding job for an outstanding price. Very professional and honest. Currently having him do the work to get my 10+ year old Honda Accord on the road again.

reviews.author: Herbert Crooks
reviews.text: Outstanding service, Juan the mechanic went above and beyond, I actually purchase the wrong brakes and he took the time and effort to go exchange the part for me because I wasn't home, I've used him in the past for transmission, and oil changes and I've been using him lately for my brakes and I'm saving lots of money and getting quality fast work. He is definitely my go to mechanic. Thanks.

reviews.author: Rose R.
reviews.text: Juan was on time and very professional.He has worked on my cars on two occasions, once for brakes and the other time an oil change. I would highly recommend him. The fact that he is mobile, makes it worth while. He is very through and never leaves a mess, he always makes sure the work area is cleaned up before he leaves.

reviews.author: Adrienne Smirnow
reviews.text: I had a flat before work. I called Juan at 7:50 and he was there at 8:00. By the time I walked my dog and grabbed my things (15 min) he was done! Juan was amazing and his prices are completely fair. I was barely delayed to work. Will be a repeat customer!

reviews.author: Paradigm Funding LLC
reviews.text: I came out and my tire was flat. Juan removed a rather large nail, plugged it and sent me on my way. His service was very courteous and professional. I will be using him again

reviews.author: Xavier Ward
reviews.text: Juan really helped me out with my alternator and oil change! I highly recommend AandJroadside! Traveled to my home and got the job done in quick time with no errors. I will definitely be coming back for further assistance!

reviews.author: Robert Neal
reviews.text: I had asked A and J to do a pre-purchase inspection, but the car failed the dealership's inspection. Even though I didn't use A and J, Juan was extremely responsive and professional in all communication and was willing to be flexible to meet my needs. I would not hesitate to use them in the future.

reviews.author: Harrison Prescott
reviews.text: Tried to add a $50 charge to jump my battery on top of the charge he quoted for fixing it which is laughable since it only takes about two minutes to jump. I said no so he canceled the job. Seems crooked. Maybe he would also try and charge extra for opening the hood. When I said Thanks, I’ll let people know he wasted my time and doesn't stick with pricing he said “he doesn’t take kindly to threats” which is kind of a threat by him if I write this review, so I'm writing this review. Don’t give him your address unless you want to risk dealing with that ridiculousness. I went back to my other mechanic who gave me a higher estimate (although ended up the same after this guy's price hike) but this other mechanic practices better business principles and I know does good work.

reviews.author: hina afaq
reviews.text: He was on time and really changed my car's battery in no time. He prices are reasonable, and he is very respectful. The best part is that he is available 24/7. Very convenient. Would definitely recommend to others.

reviews.author: Pal Kahlon
reviews.text: Needed all brake pads changed. Got a quote from a shop and he did it 1/3rd of the price on Sunday afternoon. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: SAILESH SURAPANENI
reviews.text: Juan is a man of word. He is really punctual on time and i am pretty sure that he’s my man for the car job . 10/10 . Done all my 4 brakes with him and he accomplished the job perfectly within 30 minutes .

reviews.author: Amanda Fisher
reviews.text: They were very quick to get to my vehicle and figure out the issue and fix it. I am not from this area and had no idea who to call or what to do. I just google searched a mobile mechanic. I am very happy I called them! Super friendly and professional! They are now in my contacts for any future mishaps that may happen, because I know it will. Thank you guys so very much!!!

reviews.author: Heather Grinkley
reviews.text: First time using a mobile mechanic and I must it was a great experience! Juan was very professional and explained everything to me as he was completing the work. Very flexible, affordable, and responsive.

reviews.author: Jonathan Alvarado
reviews.text: Left my car with steering problems and a messed up sway bar. Didn’t install all the parts we agreed on and still charged me the same price. Don’t waste your time. They can perform basic service like an oil change and brakes, but not real mechanic work.

reviews.author: Christopher Murphy
reviews.text: This place is really professional, quick, and they know exactly what they’re doing! Fixed my brakes and rotors in no time and fixed my bumper that was already damaged for free! Thanks will definitely recommend anyone getting their car fixed.

reviews.author: Paul Bischoff
reviews.text: Swapped the battery in my Ford escape. Came to my house in Manassas the next day and was on time. Polite and professional, and affordable prices.

reviews.author: Kamran
reviews.text: Juan did an excellent job, was on time, expert at his skill, and went the extra mile. He is now our Mechanic - trustworthy and good pricing - highly recommended!

reviews.author: Timothy Mcdowell
reviews.text: He came to my house and replaced my brakes/ rotors in a timely fashion. Very personable and professional, greatly appreciated and highly recommended

reviews.author: Emily Baker
reviews.text: Juan was very professional. Answered any questions I had and explained the work he’d perform. He was very knowledgeable. Juan completed the job faster then I expect. I would recommend him anyone.

reviews.author: Matthew Hunt
reviews.text: I broke down while driving through town and it was difficult to find anyone to come repair my truck since no tow companies would tow me anywhere and all the garages were closed on Sun. He was willing to come repair my truck on a Sunday. The only reason I did not use him was I was calling around and another service got back to me a few minutes quicker and I was desperate.

reviews.author: Sherayzia Currence
reviews.text: Juan was amazing , honest and reliable. I reached out to him late at night and he drove to me the very next morning, best mechanic around I will definitely only be going to him in the future 10/10

reviews.author: Andrew Bulas
reviews.text: This mechanic misdiagnosed my car and did not use any tools to check and see what the problem was. I ended up testing the electrical after he charged me to replace the fuel pump just by guessing on it. I wouldn’t recommend this person to anyone and he is not professional. I tried to call him and tell him that he got it all wrong and I fixed the wiring myself. He seems crooked. BEWARE!!!

reviews.author: Selena Alfaro
reviews.text: Used this service for a replacement of my starter. First time customer and the whole process was easy and quick. Very good communication from Juan and professional and fair pricing. Will be using again.

reviews.author: nelson Rodriguez
reviews.text: I highly recommend the services of A And J Roadside. I had brake service and oil change performed on my vehicle. The mechanic was knowledgeable, prompt and highly professional. I will most definitely recommend and call for future services.

reviews.author: Hector Figueroa
reviews.text: The service was great. I would like to add that his response to a recall is second to none. Very professional and willing to go the extra mile in order to fulfill his service.. I will definitely use his services in the future and will recommend him to my friends and family.

reviews.author: Hilliary Forbes
reviews.text: Very professional and service completed to satisfaction. Hired him for brake service and he even gave a courtesy overview of things to repair in the future. Definitely will recommend and continue to use in the future.

reviews.author: Kevin D. Artiga
reviews.text: Really cool guy and patient. Ran a little late but still was chill about it and got straight to work. Really easy and cool to talk too and he also points out things that are of concern just in case. Very helpful and respectful guy. I am totally calling them again for any assistance in the future.

reviews.author: Rayan Maazouz
reviews.text: I needed my rear brake pads changed and he was incredibly professional and the work was outstanding. 10/10 would recommend and use again.

reviews.author: Josh Belardo
reviews.text: Best mobile mechanic hands down. Was very helpful, responsive, and on time. The job was completed very swiftly. I would definitely recommend their services and would use them again.

reviews.author: Yamiris Lett
reviews.text: What a wonderful experience. Kept everything professional and will tell you what is wrong with other stuff on your car. He’s reliable and affordable! Will be going back !
